subscriptions_check.value: (user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (org_id IS NOT NULL)

credit_ledger_check.name: credit_ledger_check
credit_ledger_check.value: (user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (org_id IS NOT NULL)

org_scope_assignment_submissions.name: org_scope_assignment_submissions
org_scope_assignment_submissions.using:
((current_setting('app.role'::text, true) = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'superadmin'::text, 'service'::text])) OR ((user_id)::text = current_setting('app.user_id'::text, true)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM learn.assignments a
  WHERE ((a.id = assignment_submissions.assignment_id) AND ((a.org_id)::text = current_setting('app.org_id'::text, true))))))

org_scope_memberships.name: org_scope_memberships
org_scope_memberships.using: ((current_setting('app.role'::text, true) = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'superadmin'::text, 'service'::text])) OR ((org_id)::text = current_setting('app.org_id'::text, true)) OR ((user_id)::text = current_setting('app.user_id'::text, true)))

learn.v_user_program_summary.name: v_user_program_summary
learn.v_user_program_summary.definition: SELECT e.user_id, e.program_code, e.target_score, e.exam_date, ( SELECT a.scaled_score FROM learn.attempts a WHERE a.user_id = e.user_id AND a.program_code = e.program_code AND a.status = 'graded'::learn.attempt_status AND (a.mode = ANY (ARRAY['exam'::learn.attempt_mode, 'diagnostic'::learn.attempt_mode])) ORDER BY a.submitted_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_scaled_score, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM learn.srs_cards c WHERE c.user_id = e.user_id AND c.program_code = e.program_code AND c.due_at <= now() AND NOT c.suspended) AS cards_due, s.current_streak FROM learn.enrollments e LEFT JOIN learn.streaks s ON s.user_id = e.user_id WHERE e.is_active

billing.v_active_entitlements.name: v_active_entitlements
billing.v_active_entitlements.definition: SELECT user_id, program_code, feature_code, min(valid_from) AS valid_from, max(valid_to) AS valid_to FROM billing.entitlements WHERE valid_from <= now() AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > now()) GROUP BY user_id, program_code, feature_code
